author: Porkyyy
body:
Hey guys, I know that this thread has been made in the old forums, but it is completely dead now.

So, if you guys are new to this or forgot how to play it, you have to ban the player above you, and give a reason.

EXAMPLE :
 Player 1: *has a steve skin*
Player 2: Banned for not changing default skin.

Remember, do not get out of hand to the point where you are insulting others.

Have fun!
